Hi all — procurement here. Short answer: Redwood's standard policy requires a PO for vendor invoices over $5,000. Exceptions are permitted for pilot projects under $10,000 but require a completed exception request, a business justification signed by the owning AE, and finance approval.

Practical next steps to get this moving:
1) Elena — please confirm invoicing entity and currency (USD preferred).
2) Monica — submit the completed PO_Waiver_Request.docx in the internal procurement portal (I've added a link below).
3) Nimbus — sign and return the onboarding form and the DPA (we require a DPA for any vendor with data processing responsibilities).
4) Procurement will run a quick vendor verification (W-9 / tax ID on file) and a brief security intake (link to questionnaire). This usually takes 1–3 business days; exception approvals typically take 3–5 business days once submitted.

Reference links: Vendor security questionnaire (https://vendorchecks.nimbus-placeholder), Exception form: https://internal.redwood.com/procurement/exception-form/7842

If the pilot invoice needs to be paid before the PO is fully issued, we can approve a provisional payment hold (finance will flag the invoice) if finance signs off on the exception. Please note finance will require the signed SOW, onboarding form, and exception form in the portal before releasing funds.

Evelyn — FYI on potential early payment for this pilot; can you confirm whether finance can process a provisional invoice hold for up to $10k?

Thanks, Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Procurement Manager
